run_compression_tests: run the gRPC aio compression test suite to verify channel and call level compression behavior
test_channel_level_compression: test gRPC channel level compression with gzip and deflate algorithms using insecure channels
test_server_set_compression: test server side set_compression on servicer context to switch to deflate after initial metadata
test_disable_next_message_compression: test server side disable_next_message_compression to skip compression on a single response message
test_server_default_compression: test gRPC aio server default compression algorithm by setting compression on server construction
